RJ-002-OOF-REPLAY.notes: a unit is one admissible date block: features reconstructed strictly as-of, graded out of fold. Target is 20 EFFECTIVE clusters, not 20 nominal dates, and not the computable floor of 6.
RJ-002-OOF-REPLAY.title: Build a leakage-free date-blocked historical replay for uncertainty estimation

RJ-003-FALLBACK-ARM.notes: fires if RJ-002 finds that rich historical features cannot be reconstructed as-of without leakage. Units: define the reconstructible input set; fit the arm; validate its interval coverage; register the identity. A worse honest arm beats an indefinite outage — but it must be a REGISTERED identity with its own coverage validation, never the primary arm with wider error bars.
RJ-003-FALLBACK-ARM.title: Register a conservative fallback arm on reconstructible-as-of inputs, with its own validated uncertainty
